rows.name: ACT

rows.name: LingBot-VA (world-action model)
rows.verdict: 5,230 ms per inference as published: far too slow for closed-loop control.

rows.name: MolmoAct2 (Allen Institute for AI)
rows.trained: Not trained. Planned: fine-tune on the same 100 demonstrations and compare with π0.5 and FLUX
rows.verdict: Of interest for depth reasoning from the colour images alone, since the RealSense cannot see the translucent vials. Already in LeRobot as policy.type=molmoact2; its depth-reasoning (Think) variant is not in that port yet. Memory is the authors' figure for fine-tuning the action expert only (batch 8) up to the full model, on an H100 with LIBERO, not measured here.
